user.title: DashSnap
user.description: DashSnap base URL is auto-detected when possible and pre-filled below — confirm or edit it. Enter the host and port where DashSnap is running.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL with a valid scheme (http or https), host, and port.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DashSnap at that URL. Check the host/port and that DashSnap is running.
error.app_unhealthy: Reached DashSnap, but /health failed — verify DashSnap's targets configuration.

init.title: DashSnap
init.description: Change the DashSnap base URL if autodetection picked the wrong one. It is validated and health-checked before saving.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL with a valid scheme (http or https), host, and port.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DashSnap at that URL. Check the host/port and that DashSnap is running.
error.app_unhealthy: Reached DashSnap, but /health failed — verify DashSnap's targets configuration.

record.name: Record URL
record.description: Record any web page to video or screenshot via DashSnap. Provide a full URL.

url.name: URL
url.description: Full URL of the page to capture (must start with http or https).

target.name: Target
target.description: Named target from DashSnap config. Defaults to the built-in "public" target (no authentication) if omitted.

seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
seconds.description: Video length. Ignored when format is png.

delay.name: Delay (seconds)
delay.description: Wait this many seconds after the page loads before capturing.

format.name: Format
format.description: webm video or a single png screenshot.

lang.name: Language
lang.description: UI language for the captured page, e.g. de or en-GB. Sets the browser locale; for HA pages also the frontend language.

record_ha.name: Record HA dashboard
record_ha.description: Record a Home Assistant page. Provide a path — the HA base URL is applied automatically from the target config.

path.name: Page path
path.description: HA route to capture, e.g. /lovelace/0 or /history.

target.name: Target
target.description: Named HA target from DashSnap config (e.g. "ha"). Defaults to first configured target.

seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
seconds.description: Video length. Ignored when format is png.

delay.name: Delay (seconds)
delay.description: Wait this many seconds after the page loads before capturing.

format.name: Format
format.description: webm video or a single png screenshot.

lang.name: Language
lang.description: UI language for the captured page, e.g. de or en-GB. Sets the browser locale; for HA pages also the frontend language.

list_recordings.name: List recordings
list_recordings.description: List recordings stored by DashSnap. Optionally filter by format, target slug, or age.

format.name: Format
format.description: Only list this format (webm or png).

slug.name: Target slug
slug.description: Only list recordings whose filename slug matches (e.g. lovelace_0).

older_than_days.name: Older than (days)
older_than_days.description: Only list recordings captured more than this many days ago (based on the capture timestamp in the filename).

delete_recordings.name: Delete recordings
delete_recordings.description: Delete recordings stored by DashSnap. Combine filters or set Delete all; use Dry run to preview. With no filter and without Delete all, the service refuses to run.

name.name: Filename
name.description: Exact recording filename to delete, e.g. 20260720_124216_example_com.webm. Errors if the file does not exist.

slug.name: Target slug
slug.description: Delete all recordings whose filename slug matches (e.g. lovelace_0).

older_than_days.name: Older than (days)
older_than_days.description: Delete recordings captured more than this many days ago (based on the capture timestamp in the filename).

format.name: Format
format.description: Only delete recordings of this format (webm or png).

delete_all.name: Delete all
delete_all.description: Delete every recording. Required when no other filter is given.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Preview only — return what would be deleted without removing anything.
